hypotheses.justification: Split on whether N is nonempty, using the existing proof in that case. If N = ∅, choose n = 0 and z = Fin.elim0. Every f regular at all places belongs to LSpace 0, including f = 0. Obtain a transcendental x and FiniteDimensional k⟮x⟯ K from IsCurveOver.exists_separating_transcendental. The library lemma AlgebraicCurve.constantsAreBase_of_isAlgClosed_of_transcendental then identifies LSpace 0 with the range of Algebra.linearMap k K. Thus f is a base-field constant and belongs to Algebra.adjoin k ∅ by Algebra.adjoin_empty and Algebra.mem_bot. The generators' regularity condition is vacuous.
